changes: Humans no longer die: at 0 health you kneel where you fell, head bowed, your sword planted before you (or your hand on your knee), while the camera pulls out to show it.
After a few seconds the view fades and you stand up at the nearest resurrection shrine.
Villagers are defeated the same way: they kneel, then stand up again at the nearest shrine.
What you carried is left where you knelt, not dropped the moment you fall.
